## Judgment

### Expected-drift set

Three changes, all reaching only sweet16 and petunia:

- `modules/tools/ssh.nix` (new, key `user-ssh`) imported by `user-home`, which
  is imported by `sweet16-home` and `petunia-home` and nothing else.
- `modules/tools/ssh-tpm-agent.nix` (new, key `user-ssh-tpm-agent`) imported
  directly by those two host home profiles.
- `hosts/{sweet16,petunia}/home.nix` import lines.

avina and hermes carry their own `*-home` profiles and import neither
`user-home` nor the new keys. The standalone groot configurations are a
separate user on non-NixOS hosts.

Expected: sweet16 DRIFT, petunia DRIFT, everything else zero.

### Actual vs expected

Matches. `verify-drift.sh 40e429e HEAD`: sweet16 and petunia drift, avina,
hermes, groot@dualie and groot@forge byte-identical, groot@rk3588 N/A
(aarch64, not evaluable on this builder).

### What was verified beyond drift

The generated `~/.ssh/config` was rendered and compared against the file it
replaces. Structure is identical — `Include config.d/*.conf` first, then
`Host *` — with exactly three directives changed:

  ForwardAgent          yes  -> no
  StrictHostKeyChecking no   -> accept-new
  UserKnownHostsFile    /dev/null -> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

`ServerAliveInterval`, `ServerAliveCountMax` and `LogLevel` carry over
unchanged. The four hand-managed `config.d/*.conf` snippets are untouched and
keep precedence, since ssh takes the first value it obtains and the Include is
emitted ahead of the `Host *` block.

The `accept-new` switch was rehearsed against a copy of `known_hosts` before
being written: all four fleet hosts connected with no key conflict, so the
move off `UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null` cannot strand an existing host.

The generated systemd units were realised and read. `%t` expands to
`/run/user/1000`, so the permafrost socket lands on the path already named in
`~/.ssh/config.d/13-permafrost.conf`.

`ExecStartPre` exists because ssh-tpm-agent was observed exiting with status 1
on a missing `--key-dir` — the state of `~/.ssh/tpm` on both hosts right now.

### Not yet exercised

No TPM keys exist, so both agents are inert and `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` still points
at gpg-agent. Key generation needs interactive PIN entry and has not been
performed. The agentic key is still the plain ed25519 `~/.ssh/agents/my_agent_key`,
which remains loaded in the login agent — the isolation this commit builds is
structural only until that key is replaced.
